name: Tyrant Crush (Combat)
body:
All who oppose you fall before your might.

Prerequisite(s): Str 15, August Tyrant Style, Improved Unarmed Strike, BAB +3

Benefit(s): When making a single attack as a standard action while using this style, your target must make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + ½ character level + Strength modifier) or be knocked prone. Creatures taking an AC penalty from August Tyrant Style take that same penalty to this Fortitude save, and creatures with a size modifier to CMB apply that modifier to their save.

Special: This feat’s benefit applies to two-handed weapons and natural attacks. This feat’s benefit may be applied to any attack you make as a standard action.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
